item.title: GTA Online Event Week: Halloween Event Ends (October 29th-November 4th)
item.content:encoded:
• Charts
  • Community

A new GTA Online Weekly Update has begun.

Halloween Rewards

  • Play GTA Online through November 4 to receive the Brown Vintage Skull Mask
  • Complete all Weekly Challenges through November 4 to receive GTA$2,000,000 within 72 hours of completion

Kortz Center Heist Primary Targets:

The Kortz Center Heist will receive new Primary Targets.

Podium Vehicle

This week at the Casino in GTA Online, take your daily spin for your chance to win the Progen GP1, which cost $1,260,000.

Gun Van Contents

  • Knife (10%, GTA+ 20%)
  • The Shocker (FREE)

Discounts:

40% off
  • Agency Properties including Upgrades and Modifications
  • Albany Brigham
30% off
  • Vapid FMJ

Bonuses

  • 3x GTA$ & RP on Halloween Featured Series: Slasher
  • 3x GTA$ & RP on – Halloween Survivals: Ludendorff Cemetery Survival (6x for GTA+ Members)
  • 2x GTA$ & RP on Bail Office Standard and Most Wanted Targets
  • 2x GTA$ on Ghosts Exposed (4x for GTA+ Members)
  • 2x on the First Time Completion Bonus for The Diamond Casino Heist
  • Double rewards on something unusual

Weekly Challenge

The GTA Online Weekly Challenge for this week is “Complete 10 waves in a Survival without dying”. You’ll earn GTA$250,000 and the Slasher Clown Outfit.
